Figure 7k/l and Extended Figure 9f quantify TBR1 intensity after enhancer deletion. Each anatomical measurement is normalized to the Nkx intensity from the same source row. Within-mouse measurements are averaged before displaying biological samples.

The supplied data contain one WT, three heterozygous and four knockout mice. Mouse identifiers and section-level measurements are retained in the exported summaries. No new significance tests are inferred from sections or from a single WT animal.

## Inputs and saved objects

Paths are relative to the `CortexCode/` directory. **saved-results** inputs support routine rendering; **optional-rerun** inputs are read only when the corresponding analysis is enabled. Wildcards identify file collections.

| Mode | Input path | Use |
|---|---|---|
| saved-results | `data/raw_sheets/Fig7_KC/*.csv` | Fig7_KC: original measurement grids |
| saved-results | `data/raw_sheets/Extended_Fig9_KC/*.csv` | Extended_Fig9_KC: original measurement grids |

See [input locations](INPUTS.md), [saved R objects](SAVED_OBJECTS.md) and the [complete file inventory](config/file_inventory.csv) for original source names, sizes and availability. These large inputs are not part of the Git checkout.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source("R/common.R")

```
